notes: Item 19 contains two parts. Part I covers Fiscal Year 2024 performance for 216 eligible franchised studios (open at least 12 months as of Dec 31, 2024, reported at least 50 weeks of financials). Metrics are Gross Receipts (annual revenue) and Dance Packages sold, broken out by performance quartile. Part II covers ramp-up data for 38 Ramp Studios opened Jan 1, 2020 - Dec 31, 2025 across first through sixth fiscal years. Metric_scope set to 'ramp-snapshot' for Part II records as these represent year-by-year ramp progressions, not a single cohort's annual revenue. Gross Receipts figures exclude costs/expenses per franchisor's disclosure. No company-owned studios exist. All values are annual (aggregated per studio per fiscal year).
